summary: Implemented self-update target selection, check mode, refusals, install-location validation, JSON output and the embedded schema; the T1 gate cannot start because its PowerShell harness overwrites the read-only $HOME variable.
verified: vloop task gate T1 exited 1: harness.ps1 line 21 cannot overwrite read-only HOME; focused CLI tests exited 0.
notes: The command resolves an uncreated install executable through its existing parent directory, so a binary outside GOBIN still receives the specified refusal. The gate harness must use a different variable name, such as $homePath, in its Format-GatePath function.

gate_dispute.reason: The T1 gate fails inside its own PowerShell harness before it invokes the command because $HOME is a read-only automatic variable on PowerShell.
gate_dispute.evidence: Harness line 21 is '$home = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath(...)'. Running vloop task gate T1 exits 1 with 'Cannot overwrite variable HOME because it is read-only or constant.' and never reaches an assertion.
